name: Prowlers of the Barrens
summary: At the Crossroads, Sergra Darkthorn sends you to hunt prowlers of the Barrens. Their claws will show whether you can face the land’s greatest beasts.

sections.title: A True Predator
sections.body: Hunters who have faced plainstriders and zhevras now face Sergra Darkthorn’s test. Southwest of the Crossroads, savannah prowlers vanish into the scrub of the central Barrens. Unlike the herds, these great cats hunt. They wait in tall grass and ambush their prey, so unwary travelers can fall to them.

sections.title: Predator or Prey
sections.body: Sergra warns you that prowlers know how to hunt. Read the grasses and strike before a cat leaps. Bring Sergra seven prowler claws to prove you have the cunning and quick reflexes to survive Kalimdor’s deadliest wildlife.

sections.title: Stepping Toward the Champion
sections.body: Your fistful of claws proves you have learned to survive on the open savannah. Sergra is pleased with your martial skill and prepares a test of valor: summon and slay Echeyakee, the white lion revered as a champion among the Barrens’ predators.

faq.answer: Sergra Darkthorn, an experienced orc at the Crossroads, offers the hunt as one step in a traditional series of hunting rites.

faq.q: Where are the savannah prowlers located?
faq.answer: Savannah prowlers stalk tall grasses southwest of the Crossroads. They blend into the veldt and hunt zhevra and unsuspecting travelers.

faq.q: What trophies are required by Sergra?
faq.answer: Sergra asks you to bring back seven Prowler Claws, taken from the cats in direct combat, to prove you have bested them.

faq.q: What does this hunt lead to?
faq.answer: Slaying the prowlers proves you are ready to challenge Echeyakee, the renowned white lion of the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does Sergra have travelers hunt predators?
faq.answer: Sergra’s trials cull dangerous beasts that threaten the roads and test whether hunters understand the balance between predator and prey. They weed out the reckless before greater threats await.

faq.q: Are savannah prowlers dangerous to the settlement?
faq.answer: Prowlers rarely attack fortified camps like the Crossroads. They lurk near the southern roads and prey on travelers, messengers, and pack animals.

angles.text: As a hunter, stalking savannah prowlers through tall scrub trains you to track them, spot them before they strike, and subdue aggressive cats.
As a member of the Horde, helping tame the wilds around the Crossroads keeps supply convoys safe on routes between Durotar, Mulgore, and the southern outposts.
As a tauren, culling rogue predators honors the natural balance and protects vulnerable caravans crossing your ancestral hunting lands.
